subject: Post-demo: Solstice pilot — deployment checklist & sandbox access
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thompson <emma@solsticelabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Solstice pilot — deployment checklist & sandbox access

Hi Emma — great demo earlier, thanks for walking us through the ML infra and where Redwood might fit. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap (short):
- Goal: Integrate a low-latency assistant into Solstice's support pipeline (summary + suggested action items).
- Primary constraints you called out: sub-300ms p95 for short responses, strict data residency (US only for pilot), and a desire to avoid long-term network changes during the initial evaluation.

Recommended initial path: Hosted API pilot
- Why: Fastest onboarding (no VPC setup), instant model catalog access, built-in telemetry and cost tracking for a 2–3 week evaluation.
- When we see predictable steady-state throughput and need for tighter isolation, we can propose Dedicated capacity or Private VPC for phase 2.

Questions / info we need from you to provision a proper sandbox and ratecap: 
1) Traffic profile (typical tokens per request, avg tokens per response, peak concurrent users). If you can send a CSV (timestamps, requests, tokens) that helps sizing.
2) Target throughput for the pilot (desired req/s and burst tolerance).
3) Streams vs non-streaming preference for the UI (are you planning token-by-token streaming?).
4) Any compliance gating besides US residency (e.g., vendor controls, SOC2 evidence).

What we will do next on our side:
- Provision a sandbox with two endpoints (chat + generative completion) and an initial ratecap we can adjust after you share traffic.
- Enable prefix/KV caching suggestions for the assistant prompts to preserve latency and lower token usage.
- Share a lightweight pilot runbook (attachments: solstice-pilot-requirements.xlsx) and a short onboarding checklist.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you share the traffic profile and confirm target req/s by EOD Thu, Oct 1?
- Kimberly (cc) — can we schedule a 45-min SE call next week to map endpoints and set ratecaps?

Thanks again — happy to be flexible on the pilot window.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: solstice-pilot-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Solstice pilot — deployment checklist & sandbox access

Kim / Monica — forwarding Emma's thread / notes. Quick internal alignment: 

Notes / proposed config for SE to prepare:
- Start with Hosted sandbox: two endpoints mapped to their UI components (chat endpoint with streaming; summarization endpoint non-streaming).
- Initial ratecaps (recommendation): 40 req/s sustained, 100 req/s burst for 5 minutes. Token ceiling: 40k tokens/minute (we can express as token-per-second if needed).
- Latency targets to aim for in sandbox: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms (they requested sub-300ms p95 but demos often show higher with warming — we'll tune).
- Enable prefix/KV caching default and advise client on short-circuit caching for greetings and system prompts.
- Telemetry: enable token-level billing and request tracing for first two weeks.

Deliverables for Pilot package:
1) Sandbox endpoints + credentials + example curl + SDK snippet.
2) Ratecap enforcement sheet and how to request increases via support ticket.
3) Quickstart checklist (deploy client, run 100 warmup requests, validate KV cache hit %).
4) Optional: lightweight SLO TOS note for pilot (no SLA, but we monitor).

Ask: Kimberly — can you draft the sandbox request in the provisioning tool (REQ-8241) with the quotas above and attach an onboarding checklist? Monica — please prepare a one-pager CS playbook for the pilot and a short eval template so they can surface quality regressions.

Thanks — will keep Emma looped.

-Rishi
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: Solstice pilot — deployment checklist & sandbox access

Thanks Rishi — noted. A few quick operational tweaks from SE perspective: 
- Adjust initial sustained to 50 req/s (their UI has many short requests) with 120 req/s burst for 3 minutes — we can throttle down if needed.
- Token ceiling: set soft cap at 60k tokens/minute to avoid unexpected throttles; we'll monitor and add hard caps later.
- We'll expose two sandbox routes: /v1/chat/solstice and /v1/completions/solstice. Default to streaming on chat; completions will be non-streaming and limited to 1024 output tokens.
- For residency: host sandbox in us-west-2 region. No customer-managed VPC for pilot.

I'll create REQ-8241 with the above and attach pilot-runbook-internal.md. Monica, I'll leave the playbook to you.

I'll schedule a tech sync for Fri, Oct 1 at 10:00am PT unless Emma requests otherwise.

-kim
SE, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Thompson <emma@solsticelabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@solsticelabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Solstice pilot — deployment checklist & sandbox access

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and aligned with our expectations. A few answers and a timeline: 

Answers to your questions:
1) Traffic profile attached (solstice_traffic_profile.csv) — includes 2 weeks of anonymized traffic. Avg tokens/request ~ 180, avg response ~ 220 tokens. Peak concurrent users ~ 85 during business hours.
2) Pilot target: start at 50 req/s steady with ability to burst to 120 req/s for short windows.
3) We prefer streaming for the chat UI.
4) Compliance: US residency is the main requirement for pilot. We'll surface SOC2 questions if we move to Dedicated/VPC in phase 2.

Timeline / asks: 
- Please provision the sandbox in us-west-2 and share credentials by Mon, Oct 5.
- SE call: Oct 1 at 10:00am PT works for us — invite pending.
- Budget: pilot cap of $5k — please note that in the requisition so procurement is ready.

We plan to run a 3-week pilot and will evaluate performance and cost. If all looks good, we'll circle back about a Dedicated pool and VPC options for long-term isolation.

Thanks — looking forward to the SE call.

Best,
Emma Thompson
Head of ML | Solstice Labs
emma@solsticelabs.com
Attachments: solstice_traffic_profile.csv (CSV)
